fact: ITWeb Africa reports that Malawi's Ministry of ICT proposed a Government Data Sharing Regulation for the National Data Exchange Platform (Boma Lathu), which it describes as currently under implementation.

The Times reports that in 2025 the Department of e-Government failed to operationalise the Enterprise Service Bus meant to let ministries communicate, leaving services in silos, and that it faces pressure in 2026 to onboard all major ministries onto it.

An ICT expert (former ICTAM president) said in January 2026 that the Department of e-Government would be under pressure in 2026 to onboard all major ministries, departments and agencies onto the Enterprise Service Bus for interoperability of government systems, with no count of connected bodies.
The World Bank reports that the Malawi Digital Foundations Project (2017-2024, P160533) built a data-exchange platform called Bomalathu, with no statement that it is live or of what it connects.
